The unmodified `websockets-17.0.1-py3-none-any.whl` supplies the local service's
WebSocket dependency when an older portable Python installation is upgraded.
It loads directly from the wheel without pip or a network request. The wheel
includes its BSD license under `websockets-17.0.1.dist-info/licenses/LICENSE`.
